content.comment_body: I'm working on a vehicle speed monitoring project and have calculated speed in km/h using [product_name]. I want to present this value externally on a large 2-digit 7-segment display. How can I convert this value to a series of digital pulses using a single relay output, so that I can connect it to a counter and 7-segment decoder for display purposes? Any suggestions would be helpful.
Relay outputs aren't ideal for generating pulse trains. You'll need to use a transistor output module instead.

Hello [user_name], If I understand correctly, the attached file should provide a solution for your needs. Best regards [user_name]. analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are trying to use a [company_name] programmable device to display calculated vehicle speed on an external 7-segment display, but are unsure about suitable output methods. A core challenge is whether relay outputs are appropriate for generating fast digital pulse trains required by counters and decoders. Feedback highlights that relay outputs are unsuitable for this purpose and recommends a transistor output module, pointing out hardware limitations for rapid pulse generation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to output calculated analog values as pulse trains through a single relay output to facilitate easy connection with standard 7-segment display electronics.
